page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v5 is a member of the DCADSv5 server family, utilizing dedicated AMD processors built on the x86_64 architecture. This virtual machine is provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

For local storage requirements, the instance includes a bundled 614 GB local SSD. It is also designed to support Premium Storage, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. The server does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning external networking must be configured through alternative allocation methods. No dedicated GPU hardware is present on this instance.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware profile offers a standard resource distribution suitable for general-purpose workloads. The inclusion of a dedicated 614 GB local SSD provides a cost-efficient storage tier directly attached to the instance, reducing the immediate need for external block storage for temporary data. This configuration is appropriate for relational databases, web serving, application backends, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring dedicated CPU allocation and local scratch space.
